description: Ghana - Power Plants Source & Capacity is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Ghana Energy Commission (World Bank Group). This dataset consists of the different sources of ghana’s power generation and the installed capacities of these sources. Data on the actual available capacities will be provided by Energy Comission in the near future. The data was last updated in June 2014. Citation: Ghana Energy Commission & Negawatt challenge. Coverage: Ghana. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
